title: A valid cursor could cause an endless resync: positions come from one installation-wide sequence and project streams have gaps, but a cursor that was no position of the stream, a view's position or 0 included, got cursor-unknown
resolution: A cursor is a boundary of the installation-wide sequence, valid from the retention floor to its head, 0 included; cursor-expired below the floor, cursor-unknown beyond the head; contract page section 10, design decision 16, delta scenarios; a test failed before

title: Recording only the redacted input broke idempotency: two different inputs that redact alike compared equal, and an identical retry could compare unequal
resolution: Repeats compare a keyed digest (HMAC-SHA-256) of the unredacted input, recorded with the key in the outcome's transaction; contract page section 7, design decisions 10 and 18, delta requirement Idempotency before redaction; a test failed before

title: A secret split across two output chunks passed redaction, because each chunk was redacted alone, and successive output-appended events could rebuild it
resolution: A generation's output is redacted as one text: a tail that could still be part of a secret is held back until a later chunk or the generation's end decides it, and reads and events carry only released text; contract page section 7, design decision 18, delta scenario Secret split across output chunks

title: The project stream had no event for Board.workersOnline, so an empty board kept showing no workers online when the first worker came online
resolution: New BoardChangedEvent board-changed in ProjectEvent carries the project and workersOnline as readBoard returns it, also with no cards; contract page section 10, design decision 15, delta scenario; a test failed before

title: The native response requirement answered 409 for every answered request, against the 200 of an idempotent repeat in the document and the contract page
resolution: The requirement answers 200 when the key and response repeat those that answered the request, else 409, and the contract page orders that check before already-answered; scenarios for a lost response and a reused key; a test checks the document's 200 descriptions and failed before

title: The product ports delta rejected every second answer to a resolved item with conflict, also an idempotent repeat with the same key and answer
resolution: The requirement returns the first outcome for the key repeated with the same answer and rejects only another answer or the key with another answer; new scenario Idempotent repeat; product ports section 4.2 says the same
